message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a dark brown and red background. The top features the large red word "TEMPO" in a serif font. Above it are the phrases "TARIK-ULUR PEMBATASAN SOSIAL DI JAKARTA" and "CERITA DI BALIK KEMATIAN WAKIL JAKSA AGUNG" in white capital letters. Below the masthead, "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is written in small red letters.

The main headline reads "WABAH PHK" in bold white block letters. Underneath, smaller white text says "COVID-19 MENGEMPASKAN DUNIA USAHA. JUTAAN BURUH TERANCAM DIPECAT." 

The central image shows three human figures sitting on the ground, angled towards the left. They wear identical tan uniforms, hard hats, gloves, boots, and light blue surgical-style masks. Each figure sits with their arms crossed over their knees. The figure on the far right has a red toolbox next to them. The figures are rendered with heavy black outlines and yellow highlights.

At the bottom left, a barcode with "9 770126 427302" and "00008" is visible. Adjacent text lists "13-19 APRIL 2020", "RP 45.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO". A QR code is in the bottom right corner.
